name: @devdigest/agent-runner
description: DevDigest CI runner — bundles reviewer-core into one CommonJS file (dist/agent-runner.cjs) that the studio copies into exported repos.

scripts.build: esbuild src/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node20 --format=cjs --minify --legal-comments=none --banner:js="/* DevDigest agent-runner - generated bundle, do not edit. */" --outfile=dist/agent-runner.cjs
